_about: Hand-checked places for quests whose objective is an event or somewhere to go, where QuestieDB has no spot. gen.py turns each into kind e objectives (done in the order listed) and they replace QuestieDB's triggerEnd and extraObjectives for that quest. Every entry names where it was checked (src): Wowhead or warcraft.wiki.gg. map is the uiMapID, pts are {x, y} on that map. Add only what a source confirms; leave a quest out rather than guess.

<quest ID>.name: quest name, to read the file by

o.item: optional item ID to use there
